content.short: DeFi Orbit provides a portfolio management platform for multi-chain liquidity providers.
content.description: Liquidity providers spend hours each week juggling positions across scattered spreadsheets and tools, which often yields inaccurate data and missed opportunities. DeFi Orbit consolidates liquidity and lending positions across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Solana into a single real-time dashboard. Connect wallets in read-only mode (no private keys) and view precise P&L, impermanent loss, fee earnings, and health scores. Automated alerts trigger when positions drift out of range or near liquidation. Built by and for liquidity providers, it eliminates manual tracking and enables smarter decisions.
